That done, attempt to venture north. And then, take a trip west. After that, try to go south. After that, attempt to move west. If you can get around to doing that, make an effort to go north. Then, try to head north. Then, make an effort to go east. After that, go to the north. With that accomplished, try to take a trip north. And then, retrieve the apple from the floor of the austere cubicle. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
